model_answer: The FY2018–FY2020 three-year average unadjusted EBITDA margin for Walmart was 6.2%. I computed unadjusted EBITDA = operating income + depreciation & amortization and used the filing figures: 2018 (20,437 + 10,529) / 495,761 = 6.25%, 2019 (21,957 + 10,678) / 510,329 = 6.40%, 2020 (20,568 + 10,987) / 519,926 = 6.07%; the three-year average = 6.24% → 6.2% rounded to one decimal. This uses the filing lines "Operating income" and "Depreciation and amortization" as reported in the 2020 Form 10‑K.
